$comment: The HTTP contract. Both halves of TaskTrackr are written against this file: the routes publish it and the front end mirrors it. Four things are missing and they are yours; everything already filled in is a worked example, so copy its shape rather than inventing one.
$gaps: entities.tasks has two fields. The backlog needs more than two, and one story cannot work at all until the model can say when a task was due.
entities is missing the tables tasks depends on. A tag belongs to more than one task and a task carries more than one tag, so say how that is stored.
operations.listTasks publishes no query parameters and no failures. Say what may be asked for, what each parameter accepts, and what the API refuses.
operations.completeTask and operations.getOverdue are empty rows. Fill the summary, the success and the failures.
errors is empty. Every code an operation names must be declared here with its status and its meaning.

lists.description: A named list. Deleting one takes its tasks with it.

tasks.description: One thing to do, in exactly one list.

operations.summary: Every list, oldest first, each with how many of its tasks are still open.
Make a list. A name that is already taken is refused rather than merged.
